Jackals are baseline Thugs that’ve gotten some chrome and put in a little work to take some hits and move quicker. They can be deadly melee opponents, and can easily outflank or rush an untrained, ambushed target before they can react.

Humanity Loss: 3 (1d6)

Originally intended for special operations use, this quickly-abandoned implant enables projecting a one-way holographic mask over the user’s face, entirely obscuring it while still providing full vision.

External Body Cyberware. While active, this cyberware masks the user's face from external sources, including cameras. Anyone attempting a Human Perception or Lip Reading check against users with this cyberware active takes a -2 penalty to their check. Counts as an instance of Gang Colors Jewelry for Scavengers, if tweaked to the right display setting. Turning this cyberware on or off takes an Action. NOTE: This is the digital facemask that Scavs use in 2077. The World of 2077 book specifically mentions “K.E.R.S” for the Scavengers, so that’s what this was inspired by.

Type: External Body Cyberware
Install: Mall
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • The -2 applies to other people's checks, so it can't be automated from this item.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > External Body Cyberware).

Cost: 500eb (Expensive) ♦ Install: Clinic

Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)

Run the edge at top speed, choomba. There ain’t another way to live.

Speedware. As an Action, the user may activate this cyberware, after which it remains active for the next 60 seconds (20 Rounds). While active, this cyberware provides a +3 bonus to any Initiative Roll made. If activated while the user is already in an Initiative Queue, their current Initiative increases by 3, which is lost if this cyberware deactivates or its duration expires during combat. This cyberware has a 1 hour cooldown before it can be activated again. Only 1 piece of Speedware can be installed at a time.

Type: Neuralware
Install: Clinic
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • Replaces the core system's Sandevistan; use this one instead of the core item.
  • Matches the core item's setup: the +3 shows as a toggle in the initiative roll dialog.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Neuralware).
